# Golden Crest Facilities

> Women-owned commercial janitorial and facility-care company in Mount Holly, North Carolina,
> serving offices, public buildings, schools, and institutional facilities across Gaston and
> western Mecklenburg counties. NAICS 561720, PSC S201.

## Vendor summary

- Business type: Women-owned small business, independently owned and operated
- Primary NAICS: 561720 (Janitorial Services)
- Secondary NAICS: 561790 (Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings)
- Product Service Code: S201 (Housekeeping - Custodial and Janitorial)
- Location: Mount Holly, North Carolina
- Service area: Gaston and western Mecklenburg counties - Mount Holly, Belmont, Gastonia,
  Cramerton, McAdenville, Lowell, Stanley, and west Charlotte
- Status: North Carolina company in formation. SAM.gov registration in progress. No UEI, CAGE,
  or set-aside certification has been issued to date. Nothing is represented as active until
  it is issued.

## Services

- Recurring janitorial service for offices, work areas, and common spaces
- Restroom and breakroom cleaning, sanitizing, and consumable restocking
- Lobby and public-area opening and closing readiness
- Floor care, interior glass, high-dusting, and fixture detail
- Turnover and move-out cleaning
- Event reset cleaning

Not offered: medical or infection-control sanitation, hard-floor stripping and waxing, carpet
extraction, exterior or above-ground-level window work, regional multi-site contracts.

Quote requests and procurement inquiries are submitted through the form on the home page.
A monitored business email and phone line are being established at formation.
